versions.changelog:
Initial release of the avi-assess skill for measuring and verifying agent autonomy.

- Implements the Agentic Verifiable Independence (AVI) framework, providing autonomy assessment across five weighted dimensions.
- Supports self-assessment, cross-agent verification, and on-chain reputation registration.
- Includes assessment scripts, CLI wrapper, and integration examples for agent marketplaces and reputation systems.
- Provides tiered scoring and detailed reporting with verifiable proofs for each autonomy dimension.
- Designed specifically for AI agent autonomy; not intended for general performance or human assessments.
